purpose: Backend restart and cold-process requests; not detection accuracy

preflight_notes: Initial strict memory equality check stopped before stack creation or analysis. A sub-MiB reported-allocation difference is retained as a condition difference, not treated as a different runtime image.

diagnosis.interpretation: The client-visible cold trial failed. The video completed later in the backend. The later read does not replace the failed trial or establish its successful API latency.

decision: Ali chose to retain the incomplete attempt and create a separate proxy-recovery issue before changing the frozen candidate.
